target_context: JC compatible finite truncations and the proposed infinite formal-arc limit
intended_conclusion: the compatible truncation tower has a limiting point

hypotheses.why: The campaign records finitely many exact-affine models, not a typed directed inverse system.
No campaign object is proved to be the scheme-theoretic inverse limit of the truncation stages.
The truncation transition maps have not been materialized and checked as affine morphisms.
Some bounded blocks have solutions over an algebraic closure, but nonemptiness of every stage is not established.
Quasi-compactness is mathematically plausible for affine stages but is not bound as a campaign premise.

application_premises.statement: a point of the scheme limit corresponds to a JC formal arc with the declared source semantics
application_premises.why: The source-to-truncation semantics and point universe have not been composed through an infinite limit.
